Contact feedback led the controller to infer a grasp posture, but the terminal physical sample retained wrist_roll=-0.001073312 rad. The 20.005 s simulation budget was exhausted and the independent Harness task verdict was FAIL; formal_episode was false.
robotstudio_so101.lesson: For a robot-arm task that requires end-effector orientation control, the public capability interface must expose an explicit wrist-rotation capability rather than assuming Cartesian position control or contact feedback also controls wrist orientation.
robotstudio_so101.recommendation: For a later matched run, provide a typed compositional leaf such as set_wrist_roll, expose observable wrist-roll feedback, and validate the leaf independently before using it in high-level control. Do not treat this recommendation as evidence that the remediation or task has passed.
robotstudio_so101.scope: Robot arms and manipulation tasks whose success depends on end-effector wrist orientation; eligible only for a prospectively declared later matched run and not for B1 input.
